configurations.name: prototypes
configurations.//: Static file server for the prototypes. Nothing depends on a specific port — no OAuth callbacks, webhooks or CORS — so autoPort lets it move if 4321 is taken (a stray server, or a colleague's). python3 -m http.server takes its port positionally and ignores $PORT, so it is wrapped in a shell that reads the assigned port and falls back to 4321.
